question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Enthusiasm
solution:
The correct answer is "**Apathy.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'antonym' means a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Now, let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• The word "enthusiasm" means **intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.** (उत्साह)
 
 
• Example: The kids were filled with enthusiasm when they heard about the trip.
 
 
 
• **Apathy means lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern****.** (उदासीनता)
 
 
• Example: There is widespread apathy among politicians.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "apathy" is the antonym of the word "enthusiasm."

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vehemence means the display of strong feeling or passion; it is a synonym of enthusiasm.(उत्साह)
 
• Zeal means great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or objective; it is a synonym of enthusiasm. (उत्साह)
 
• Passion means strong and barely controllable emotion; it is a synonym of enthusiasm.(जुनून)
